# handoff-desk

> handoff-desk is a small MCP server that runs on your computer. When you tell Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another MCP client to "hand this to my agent", it writes a markdown note into a folder you own, optionally rings a heads-up (email, Telegram or Slack), and later reads the agent's reply from the same note. The agent can be one on the same computer, OpenClaw, or a cloud agent reached through a private git repository. No hosted service, no account, no telemetry. MIT licence, by Voyageur Works.

Set up (Node.js 22 or newer): `npx -y @voyageurworks/handoff-desk setup`
Demo desk only: `npx -y @voyageurworks/handoff-desk init ~/handoff-demo`
